thread:
Morgan: quick post-incident sync — putting the RCA action items here so they're tracked. TL;DR: external scan led to a leaked key alert, contained within 30m, no data exfil.
Alex: thanks. can you paste the RCA link?
Morgan: RCA draft: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-452 — rough notes, will convert to doc today. still needs root cause writeup + timeline.
Jisoo: action I took: rotated affected API key, added rule to KMS policy to restrict `getSecret` to service accounts only. logged rotation in kms-audit (aws-cloudtrail link).
Sam: added infra ticket to enforce vault-backed secrets for all deploy pipelines — INF-453. Est 2 wks. @Alex can you prioritize for next sprint?
Alex: yes, will slot it. also, we should update RBAC doc for engineers — too many broad roles granting `secrets:*`. I'll create a PR with proposed least-privilege roles.
Morgan: noted. big action items list (short):\n• INF-452 RCA doc (owner: Morgan) — due: 2024-05-30\n• INF-453 Vault migration (owner: Sam) — due: 2024-06-14\n• RBAC cleanup PR (owner: Alex) — due: 2024-06-07\n• Audit retention policy review (owner: Jisoo) — due: 2024-06-01\n• Tabletop exercise (owner: Sam/Alex) — schedule by 2024-06-10\n\nJisoo: for audit retention, note that current KMS logs are 90d. We should propose 1yr for keys used in infra. I will open a docs PR with justification and cost estimate.
Alex: good call. add a metric to Console: show "secrets access by principal" for last 30/90/365d. Prod dashboard ticket INF-460.
Sam: tabletop: propose 1.5h session, include oncall, sec-eng, devex, and platform. goal: verify rotation + comms runbook. I can run facilitation. preferred week of 6/10.
Morgan: comms follow-up: we already notified impacted customers via secure channel. Need a short internal postmortem summary on #incidents and to execs — I'll draft and circulate tomorrow.
Alex: small technical follow-up — how did the leak happen? appears to be an env var accidentally committed in a non-prod repo with CI access; original token was long-lived. adding check to pre-commit/CI to fail on secret patterns.
Jisoo: I'll add a policy: block long-lived personal tokens >30d for service accounts via token policy enforcement, and add alerting when tokens are created with wide scopes.
Sam: vuln triage note: flagged the scanner rule that missed the repo (false negative) — created rule update MR in our scanner repo. link: https://git.redwood/scanner/mr/78
incident-bot: INCIDENT SUMMARY: 2024-05-24 01:12Z — Detected leaked key in non-prod repo, contained by 01:42Z. No customer data exfiltrated. Severity: P2. Action items assigned.
Morgan: next steps: I'll convert RCA draft to final, tag owners, and add all tickets to post-incident board. Please add any missing items in replies. :thumbsup:\nAlex: added RBAC checklist to INF-452 comments.\nSam: booked tentative tabletop slot 2024-06-11 16:00 UTC (calendar invite sent).\nJisoo: PR for KMS policy changes opened: https://git.redwood/security/pull/314 — please review.
Morgan: thanks everyone. we'll close out items as they complete and do a follow-up in 4 weeks to ensure compliance changes rolled out.
